title: Does Charging Overnight Ruin Your Battery?
topic: Phones slow or cap charging near full: Apple's Optimized Battery Charging holds around 80% until you wake; Samsung's Protect Battery caps at 85%. Scope by vendor.
hook: Your phone charges to 80%. Then stops. On purpose.
twist: Modern phones learn your routine and finish charging just before you unplug.
pinnedComment: Plug in overnight, or unplug at 80%? Tell me 👇
commentPrompt: Plug in overnight, or unplug at 80%? Tell me.

sources.label: iGeeksBlog - Optimized Battery Charging on iPhone

weaknesses: Third-party sources only: fetch Apple and Samsung support pages on script day. Say 'on iPhone' / 'on Samsung', never 'all phones'. The hard 80% limit exists only on newer iPhones (iPhone 15 and later, iOS 18+).
